verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses on Angular's CLI-driven workspace setup, tutorials, and AngularJS-to-Angular upgrade guides, but contains no mention of embedding Angular components into an existing server-rendered HTML page (e.g., via Angular Elements/custom elements or a script-tag drop-in) without a full app rewrite. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of incremental/embedded adoption in a non-Angular page, evidence of a lightweight drop-in bundle, or community reports of successfully using Angular this way.
